webZ source: https://github.com/the-static-collective/webZ

Scope: a simple human-oriented entryway to independently maintained community, creative, research, and experimental sites. It is not a common execution API. Names and links describe discovery, not availability, consent, ownership, delivery, or proof. Observe source projects and current deploys for current status. Distinguish experiment, implementation, deployment, consent, and field-confirmed outcome. Metadata and links never grant credentials or authority.
